At HCSC, our employees are the cornerstone of our business and the foundation to our success. We empower employees with curated development plans that foster growth and promote rewarding, fulfilling careers.

Join HCSC and be part of a purpose-driven company that will invest in your professional development.

SUMMARY: This position is responsible for creating reports, insights and analytics in support of the division. This person will create specifications for reports and analysis based on business needs and possibly providing consultation to users and working on cross-functional teams to address the division's issues. Producing datasets and reports for analysis using system reporting tools and possibly performing research and assisting in analyzing data related to the division's strategic initiatives and broader research needs. This role will interface between the business and divisional data teams to generate tools to be leveraged in building analysis and reports which are actionable within the business environment and work closely with customers to build relationships and continuously gaining a deeper understanding of the division's data in order to meet business needs. Will also analyze complex business problems and issues using data from internal and external sources to provide insight to decision-makers while identifying and interpreting trends and patterns in datasets to locate influences. This person will be responsible for building PowerPoint presentation from data available and presenting to team members of all levels and partner divisions.


Required Job Qualifications:

Bachelor Degree and 2 year experience in data analysis and information reporting data OR 4 year experience in data analysis and information reporting data.

Analyze possible solutions using standard procedures to solve routine or basic problems.

Use best practices and knowledge of internal or external business issues to improve products or services.

Solve complex problems with guidance.

Produce data sets and reports for analysis using SQL, Excel or other reporting tools.

Verify accuracy of reports and provide insights.

Knowledge of SQL, SAS and/or Teradata or other reporting tools / languages.

Work with both internal and external data

Work on multiple projects simultaneously, both independently and as part of a team to accomplish goals.

Learn needed skills by performing assigned work

Preferred Job Qualifications:

Familiarity with Quest systems - highly preferred.

Knowledge and/or experience of MCO (Managed Care Organization) - highly preferred.

Education and/or background in mathematics, economics, or statistics.

Experience with network adequacy.

Strong PowerPoint and full MS Suite knowledge.

Sponsorship will not be provided for this role.

This is a Telecommute (Remote) role.
